```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(ggplot2)
library(irr)
library(scales)
```


```{r}
gemini_similarity <- read_excel("gemini_3_flash/nih_project_similariy_score_gemini_3_flash.xlsx")

gpt_similarity <- read_excel("gpt_5_mini/nih_project_similariy_score_gpt_5_mini.xlsx")
```

```{r}
gemini_avg_sim <- gemini_similarity%>%
  group_by(CiteID,Domain) %>%
  summarise(
    gemini_mean = mean(similarity),
    gemini_median = median(similarity),
    gemini_worst = min(similarity),
    gemini_best = max(similarity))


gpt_avg_sim <- gpt_similarity%>%
  group_by(CiteID,Domain) %>%
  summarise(
    gpt_mean = mean(similarity),
    gpt_median = median(similarity),
    gpt_worst = min(similarity),
    gpt_best = max(similarity))

Passages_similarity <- gemini_avg_sim %>%
  inner_join(gpt_avg_sim, by = c("Domain", "CiteID")) 



write_xlsx(Passages_similarity, "Passages_similarity.xlsx")

```


```{r}
#Sine it chooses and uses all 5 passages, the analysis can be on the best performing passage

passages <- read_excel("Passages_similarity_best.xlsx")

overall_GPT <- summary(passages$gpt_best)
overall_Gemini <- summary(passages$gemini_best)


domain_GPT <- passages %>% 
  group_by(Domain) %>% 
  summarise(
    gpt_median = median(gpt_best, na.rm = TRUE),
    gpt_IQR = paste(
      quantile(gpt_best, probs = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 
      "-", 
      quantile(gpt_best, probs = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )

domain_Gemini <- passages %>% 
  group_by(Domain) %>% 
  summarise(
    gemini_median = median(gemini_best, na.rm = TRUE),
    gemini_IQR = paste(
      quantile(gemini_best, probs = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 
      "-", 
      quantile(gemini_best, probs = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )

```
